tasks.name: commit
tasks.when: You are about to create a Git commit.

tasks.name: open-pr
tasks.when: You are preparing to open a pull request.

core_skills.name: verify-behavior
core_skills.when: Before declaring a change done, verify its behavior through the normal entry point.

core_skills.name: recheck-assumptions
core_skills.when: If two fixes based on the same assumption fail the same check, test the assumption before trying again.
